profile.headline: Web Software Developer at Goodville Mutual Casualty Company
profile.geoLocationName: Staten Island, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the software development industry. Skilled in Java, C#, VB, Android, and Python. Strong information technology professional with a Bachelor of Science focused in Computer Science from St. John's University.

positions.title: Junior Application Developer
positions.description:
-Rewrite critical system modules to resolve bugs and improve efficiency
-Develop screens as part of the business analyst's designs to meet the client's expectations
-Configure the front end screen (written in VB code) to properly send the information from what the user can see, to the stored procedures in the back end
-Implement back end SQL stored procedures to update, insert, or delete data as necessary from the front end

positions.title: Junior Java Developer
positions.description:
-Develop screens as part of their web applications using JSPs with embedded Java scriptlets, HTML, and JavaScript for both their public facing, and private facing website, designed to take various pieces of information from applicants that would then later be verified by a state employee
-Debug screens and fix errors within them
-Rewrite critical elements within both sites to to make it accessible to the physically disabled (W3C Compliance)
-Implement a mobile solution so that users could view and submit applications from their mobile device

positions.title: PC technician
positions.description:
-Diagnose and remove spyware, viruses, and malware based on customer's issues with their PC
-Repair hardware issues present in the computer, both remotely and locally
-Upgrade customer’s PC software and install hardware components
-Replace components based on the user's changing PC needs
-Install both protection software, as well as backup systems in order to maintain the customer's data integrity
-Build computers from start to finish based on user's individual needs and desires
-Install and maintain home networks for a wide-range of needs, including parental controls and overall usage

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
-Reproduce reported bugs in the company's software, as well as discover new bugs with constant testing
-Report findings to the senior developer
-Worked on their project to develop the MMO “Guns of Icarus Online” using Unity/C#
